name: rankmath-seo-wp
description: Write WordPress articles that pass Rank Math's own SEO tests: block-editor HTML with valid HowTo and FAQ blocks, a verifier that scores the article the way the plugin does, and rules read from the plugin's source. Unofficial: not made by or affiliated with Rank Math.

wp_ssh_host.title: SSH user and host
wp_ssh_host.description: Only for publishing or batch-fixing posts over WP-CLI: the SSH login for your WordPress server, e.g. user@your-wp-host.example.com. Export it as WP_SSH_HOST for a tool run. The tools contact only this server.

wp_ssh_key.title: SSH private key path
wp_ssh_key.description: Path to the SSH private key used to log in to that server, e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa. Only the path is stored; the key stays on your machine and is used by ssh. Export it as WP_SSH_KEY for a tool run.

wp_path.title: WordPress path on the server
wp_path.description: The WordPress install directory on that server, e.g. /path/to/wordpress. Export it as WP_PATH for a tool run.
